title: "I was trying to let him down easy" (date stalking)
heading: "I was trying to let him down easy" (date stalking)

notes.coreMechanism: soft or minimized rejection can be exploited by a boundary-ignoring pursuer as continued access, so repeated contact and reinterpretation matter more than romance framing
notes.mainLimit: do not blame the targeted person for trying to be kind, and do not overcall every awkward follow-up as a fixed stalking doctrine
